transcript:
agent: Hello, this is Ada, an AI assistant from Demo Bank. This call may be recorded. Is now a good time?
customer: Yeah, go ahead.
agent: I noticed your 25000 naira transfer on 12 September failed. Is that what stopped you using the app?
customer: Yes, they debited me and the money never reached my guy. I've not seen the refund since.
agent: I'm really sorry about that. I can open a priority reversal ticket right now. Would that help?
customer: Please do. If it's sorted I'll come back.
agent: Done. You'll get an update within 24 hours. Thanks for your time.
